name: Compressed olive and terracotta paper pulp | mobile terrain derivative v6
source: User-provided Olive Fiber texture set. Base color, normal and roughness structure are retained; the sphere render is never used as a texture.
derivation: Deterministic periodic filtering of user-provided 2048px color and +Y normal maps to 1024px. Reduced broad normal lobes, retained source fibers and layer boundaries, added seeded short fiber and micropore detail. Soil has its own reduced flake normal; no sphere render, photographed lighting or reference screenshot is sampled. ORM is authored micro-pore AO, roughness at least .94, zero metalness.
usage: Olive maps for grass tops and exposed pulp lip; dirt maps for cube sides/bottom. World-space UVs; no baked lighting.

textures.role: sRGB olive layered pulp top base color
linear tangent-space OpenGL +Y grass fiber normal; blue channel faces forward
linear R=micropore AO G=high paper roughness B=zero metalness
sRGB terracotta remap of layered pulp dirt base color
linear tangent-space OpenGL +Y compressed soil fiber normal; blue channel faces forward
linear R=micropore AO G=high paper roughness B=zero metalness
